SELECT e.Name
FROM employee e
JOIN evaluation ev ON e.Employee_ID = ev.Employee_ID
GROUP BY e.Employee_ID, e.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT e.Name
FROM employee e

GROUP BY e.Employee_ID, e.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
